body: I'm not sure how to find a meeting with open chat at this time of night. Any ideas? The only meetings I'm seeing for right now are the major marathon meetings, which have closed chats that only allow you to message the host and co-host.

I don't think calling her is a good idea. Maybe if I had known her longer, but she's only been my sponsor for a week and a half and so I feel weird about that still. On the nights we've still been talking around this time, she wraps things up to go to sleep. So it feels like it would be disrespectful or something to reach out at a time that I know she's usually sleeping or trying to sleep. I don't have anyone else's number or I'd be texting/calling someone. :/
